title: Test Ad Hooks Before the Budget Goes Out
summary: Pick the hooks and creatives most likely to work from a niche study, then test a small set before spending the full ad budget.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you already run paid social; the value is fewer weak tests, not guaranteed sales.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Spend goes to angles you have already screened, not guesses.
Weak creatives get dropped before they use up the budget.
who_its_for: Small brands that run paid social.
Marketers who manage ad budgets for clients.

steps.name: You
steps.does: Tests a small budget and keeps what holds

steps: Name the product, audience and offer you want to test.
Pick the top scored hooks from the niche study.
Build the stills and clips for the shortlisted hooks.
Test a small set in your ad account and keep the ones that hold.
guardrails: Test on a small budget before you scale any creative.
Check ad claims and platform rules yourself before you run them.
